name: Morty's Cafe "The Iconic" Cheddar Burger & Sweet Potato Fries (Plain Mod)
whyItWorks: A fresh smashburger with aged cheddar on a toasted bun right on the edge of USU campus; pairing with a small side of cooked sweet potato fries gives you soluble beta-carotene fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Iconic" Burger (or substitution turkey/chicken patty) with cheddar only—skip raw onions, lettuce, tomato, and spicy fry sauce.
watchOuts: Skip the fiery Blue Fire Burger (jalapeños/buffalo sauce) and Sunrise Burger if sensitive to greasy hash browns
